Looking at the failing test, I can see that the `save` method in the `Contact` class needs to actually save the contact to the contacts storage. The test is trying to call `contact.save()` and then verify that the contact can be retrieved from `Contact.objects.get(contact_id=contact.id)`.

Looking at the code, I can see that:
1. `Contact` has an `objects` attribute which is a `ContactManager`
2. `ContactManager` has a `save` method that stores contacts in the `CONTACTS` OrderedDict
3. The `save` method in `Contact` should delegate to `self.objects.save(self)`
